desc: Use \(P_r=\sum_{i=1}^r A_i\) and expand \((P_r-P_j)^K=\sum_{t=0}^K(-1)^t\binom Kt P_r^{K-t}P_j^t\).
Initialize moments with \(P_0=0\), query the contribution for each \(r\), then update moments with powers of \(P_r\).
Precompute binomial coefficients modulo 998244353 and handle modular signs and zero powers correctly.
Produce and sanity-check the final Python program with stdin/stdout formatting and code delimiters.
